examples.text: Он идёт на второй срок.
examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'лноваться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'worry'.

examples.text: Не волнуйся.
examples.trans: Don't worry.

examples.text: Я волнуюсь.
examples.trans: I'm nervous.

examples.text: Не волнуйся, не буду.
examples.trans: Don't worry, I won't.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'we', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Сейчас это самый известный модный модельер.
examples.trans: Right now he is the most famous fashion designer.

examples.text: Хочешь, мы тебя в номере покормим?
examples.trans: If you want, can we feed you in your room?

examples.text: Ладно, ребята, тогда мы с вами договорились.
examples.trans: Alright, guys, then we have a deal.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Просто позвони ему сегодня и скажи.
examples.trans: Just call him today and tell him.

examples.text: Саша попросил меня подменить его ночью.
examples.trans: Sasha asked me to cover for him tonight.

examples.text: Моя Елена будет просто очень счастлива.
examples.trans: My Elena will simply be very happy.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'покойно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Ладно, мы до завтра спокойно потерпим.
examples.trans: Alright, we will calmly be patient until tomorrow.

examples.text: Успокойся, послушай музыку и тихо посиди.
examples.trans: Calm down, listen to music and sit quietly.

examples.text: Не волнуйся, мы просто спокойно поговорим.
examples.trans: Do not worry, we will just talk calmly.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'говорить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'talk', paired with 'говорить'.

examples.text: Не волнуйся, мы просто спокойно поговорим.
examples.trans: Do not worry, we will just talk calmly.

examples.text: Мы просто спокойно поговорим.
examples.trans: We will just talk calmly.

examples.text: Поговори с ним.
examples.trans: Talk to him.
